about: AI hints in forge.patch, per card. 'since' = when the hint went live; usage data older than that was measured without it.

Academy Instructor.hint: Cast early in the main phase (raised priority), so the AI doesn't sit on it.

Agate Instigator.hint: Cast early in the main phase (raised priority), so the AI doesn't sit on it.

Black Market Connections.hint: Cast early. Modes by life total: 30+ Treasure + Shapeshifter + draw; 25-29 Treasure + Shapeshifter; 12-24 Treasure + draw; under 12 Treasure only. Without this the AI almost always just draws and never makes the Shapeshifter.

Caesar, Legion's Emperor.hint: Attacks with something so he triggers, sacrifices a token, takes the Soldiers plus card draw (or damage once the board is wide).

Pact of Negation.hint: Only counter what really matters: a board wipe, a spell aimed at our cards, or a big threat (mana value 6+). Needs 7+ lands so paying next upkeep doesn't eat the whole turn, unless it's protecting our board. Without this the AI fires it at a random spell the moment it has 5 lands.
